title: Auto-update: an accepted update ships through its own pull request, and uncommitted orion files are offered for shipping
summary: orion's session-start check no longer writes an update into the main folder: under auto, or on a yes under ask, it asks the agent to ship the update through its own worktree and pull request, merged on green and then pulled; a new local check offers to ship orion files left uncommitted (a first install included, with its hook, config and rules import), never discarding them.
lessons_learned: A skill that ships files from the main folder must handle a first install nobody committed: the hook, config and rules-import files sit outside the manifest, and round 1 caught that they were left out.

deferred.what: The suite row still says the suite proves a failing and a working auto-update, the check paragraphs omit the uncommitted-files offer and say an auto update is seen in the same session, so the next agent changing check or its tests is pointed at behaviour that no longer exists.
deferred.why: CLAUDE.md changes only on the person's word and a person merges it.

deferred.what: Nothing checks whether the default branch already carries the new version: with the main folder on a branch cut before an update merged, auto asks to ship at every session start and each run merges a pull request holding only a changelog line, and uncommitted files copied from that branch can undo the update's change to them.
deferred.why: Raised on the confirming review after an approval, so recorded instead of fixed.
